# KalaCUBE

> KalaCUBE is a home for India's artists — an online platform and marketplace to discover, showcase, and buy original Indian art across Handicraft, Visual Art, and Performing Arts. Art Lives Here.

## What KalaCUBE does

- Showcases artist portfolios and original artworks from artists across India.
- Lets visitors browse and buy original art by art style, category, and medium.
- Gives artists a home to build a portfolio, tell their story, and reach an audience.
- Organizes work across three dimensions: Handicraft, Visual Art, and Performing Arts.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://kalacube.com): Overview of KalaCUBE and featured work.
- [Explore the Gallery](https://kalacube.com/explore): Browse all original artworks, filter by art type, and search.
- [Artists](https://kalacube.com/all-artist): Discover artists and their portfolios.
- [Categories](https://kalacube.com/all-categories): Browse art by style and category.
- [Journal](https://kalacube.com/blog): Stories of India's artists and handmade art.
- [AI and the Future of Human Art](https://kalacube.com/blog/ai-and-the-future-of-human-art): Why human-made art, and platforms that support real artists, matter in the age of AI.
- [Events](https://kalacube.com/events): Exhibitions, live demos, and workshops (coming soon).
- [FAQs](https://kalacube.com/faqs): Answers for artists and buyers.

## Join & contact

- [Join KalaCUBE](https://kalacube.com/auth/register): Create an artist account.
- [Sign in](https://kalacube.com/auth/login): Access your account.
- For questions, see the [FAQs](https://kalacube.com/faqs).
